destinations.name: Paga Crocodile Pond
destinations.description: Famous sacred crocodile pond where visitors can interact with tame crocodiles. The pond is home to over 100 crocodiles that are considered sacred by the local community. A unique cultural and wildlife experience.
highlights: Touch and take photos with crocodiles
Learn about traditional beliefs and conservation
destinations.entry_fee: GHS 20 for adults, GHS 10 for students (plus optional guide tip)
destinations.accessibility: Accessible by car, 10 minutes from Paga border
destinations.location_details: Paga town, near Ghana-Burkina Faso border. 2 hours drive from Bolgatanga.

destinations.name: Tongo Hills (Tengzug Shrine)
destinations.description: Sacred hills and ancient shrine complex built into massive rock formations. The Tengzug Shrine is a mystical site with deep spiritual significance, featuring centuries-old traditional architecture integrated with natural rock formations.
highlights: Ancient shrine complex in rock formations
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to April (dry season, easier climbing)
destinations.accessibility: Requires hiking and climbing, moderate fitness needed
destinations.location_details: Tongo village, 20km east of Bolgatanga. Accessible by car and hiking.

destinations.name: Pikworo Slave Camp
destinations.description: Historic slave camp site where captured slaves were held before being transported to the coast. A sobering reminder of the transatlantic slave trade, featuring the original holding areas, punishment stones, and market grounds.
highlights: Market ground where slaves were traded
destinations.location_details: Near Paga, Upper East Region. Can be combined with Paga Crocodile Pond visit.

destinations.name: Sirigu Women's Village
destinations.description: Community-based tourism initiative showcasing traditional Kassena wall painting and pottery. The village is famous for its beautifully decorated houses with intricate traditional designs created by local women.
destinations.accessibility: Accessible by car, 30 minutes from Bolgatanga
destinations.location_details: Sirigu village, near Bolgatanga, Upper East Region.

destinations.name: Bolgatanga Market (Bolga Basket Market)
destinations.description: Famous market known for traditional handwoven baskets, leather goods, and crafts. One of West Africa's best markets for authentic handicrafts. The colorful Bolga baskets are internationally recognized.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: Morning (7 AM - 12 PM) for best selection
destinations.location_details: Central Bolgatanga, Upper East Region. Main market day is every 3 days.

accommodations.name: Sand Gardens Hotel
accommodations.description: Comfortable mid-range hotel in central Bolgatanga with good facilities and restaurant. Popular with NGO workers and tourists exploring the Upper East.
accommodations.additional_info: Central location, good base for exploring Upper East attractions.

accommodations.name: Black Star Hotel Bolgatanga
accommodations.description: Budget-friendly hotel offering basic comfortable accommodations in Bolgatanga. Clean rooms and friendly service at affordable rates.
accommodations.additional_info: Good budget option for travelers exploring Upper East.

accommodations.name: Sirigu Women's Village Homestay
accommodations.description: Community-based homestay experience in traditional Kassena compound. Immersive cultural experience with local families, including meals and cultural activities.
accommodations.additional_info: Authentic cultural immersion, proceeds support local women. Book in advance.
